newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends at highs after NY-led rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends at highs after NY-led rally.

text.p: Nearby white sugar futures closed at their highs on Thursday, tracking a strong New York raws market.
August finished up $3.40 at $323.70 per tonne after finding support at its low of $320.00.
The move was mainly a reflection of technical strength in July raws, which jumped in New York.
But London volume was light at 1,273 lots, with a good portion of AA business, traders said.
October closed $2.60 firmer at $317.30, just off its peak of $318.00.
In Paris, August ended $2.50 higher at $322.50 and October $2.00 stronger at $317.00.
